description: JS analysis against the installed layout: an unused dependency, a phantom import of a transitive dependency, a script that runs a binary of another package's dependency, and one that runs a workspace member's binary without listing the member; `<pm> run tool` in b shows whether the layout provides that binary.

pnpm/isolated.reason: pnpm's isolated linker links a member's binaries only into the packages that list it.

yarn.reason: Yarn Berry runs only the binaries of a package's own dependencies, under every linker.

bun/default.reason: Bun installs a new workspace isolated (bun.lock configVersion 1), which links no member binary into b.

bun/isolated.reason: Bun's isolated linker links a member's binaries only into the packages that list it.
